suppress.notes: Risk accepted (docs/SECURITY-EXCEPTIONS.md, SEC-001): CVE-2026-47884 needs Spring MVC XsltView, which this service does not use. Open-source fix only in Spring Framework 7.0.9; upgrade to Spring Boot 4 planned.

Risk accepted (docs/SECURITY-EXCEPTIONS.md, SEC-002): CVE-2026-47890 needs view fragments streamed over Server-Sent Events, which this service does not use. Open-source fix only in Spring Framework 7.0.9.

Risk accepted (docs/SECURITY-EXCEPTIONS.md, SEC-003): Spring Framework 6.2.19 advisories that need features this service does not use (WebFlux, RSocket, SpEL on user input, XSLT/FreeMarker views, SSE, URL redirect helpers, property-path data binding). Open-source fixes only in Spring Framework 7.0.9; upgrade to Spring Boot 4 planned.

False positive (SEC-004): CVE-2026-42154 is a denial of service in the Prometheus server's remote-read endpoint (Go). It is matched to the Java Micrometer registry only through the generic CPE prometheus:prometheus.
